task_contract.model_api: model.py defines train(samples, seed) -> finite list of coefficients and predict(coefficients, row) -> finite scalar. Training rows are [features,target]; row has two real features. Standard library only.
task_contract.control: Proposal.controls must equal supported_controls exactly; the incumbent is the paired control.
task_contract.execution: Controller trains twice in fresh isolated processes per seed, checks repeatability and finite responses, and calculates validation quality itself. Candidate receives validation features but never validation targets.
task_contract.scope: Improve model source autonomously; no source-template whitelist. No new files outside model/. Serialized coefficient limit is not a proof of total internal model complexity.
task_contract.knowledge: Return append-only provisional explanation with existing graph IDs; empty patch is valid. All roles must preserve supplied frozen identities.
